一句话作用: Deploy web projects to Netlify using the Netlify CLI (npx netlify). Use when the user asks to deploy, host, publish, or link a site/repo on Netlify, including preview and production deploys.
关键输入: - Netlify CLI : Installed via npx (no global install required) - Authentication : Netlify account with active login session - Project : Valid web project in current directory - When sandboxing blocks the deployment network calls, rerun with sandbox permission…
关键输出: After deployment, report to user: - Deploy URL : Unique URL for this deployment - Site URL : Production URL (if production deploy) - Deploy logs : Link to Netlify dashboard for logs - Next steps : Suggest netlify open to view site or dashboard
